study type: Cohort study with alternating intervention periods
outcome: Pulmonary hemorrhage or death before 7 days
cohort: The study included 615 consecutively admitted infants born at less than 28 weeks gestation.
finding: Prophylactic indomethacin was associated with a significantly lower incidence of serious pulmonary hemorrhage and pulmonary hemorrhage or death before 7 days in preterm infants.
followup_time: Up to 7 days postpartum for some outcomes (e.g., pulmonary hemorrhage or death)
